name: CDB
recent: CelcomDigi 近期出现董事会变动，June Solbekk 与 Elisabeth Melander Stene 于 11 月 18 日辞任董事。EPF 在 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。公司推出预付费流媒体通行证，并公布反诈骗与 ESG 进展。
notable: June Solbekk 于 11 月 18 日辞任董事会成员。
Elisabeth Melander Stene 于 11 月 18 日辞任董事会成员。
公司为预付费客户推出每月 1 令吉起的流媒体通行证。
risks: 首席策略、转型与监管官 Datuk Kamal Bin Khalid 于 8 月 18 日以每股 2.90 令吉出售 15,000 股。
EPF 在 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 31.86 亿令吉，环比下降 0.7%，同比上升 0.3%；净利润为 3.98 亿令吉，环比下降 4.8%，同比下降 9.3%；净利率为 12.5%，低于上一季度的 13.0%。

recent_en: CelcomDigi saw boardroom changes with June Solbekk and Elisabeth Melander Stene ceasing as directors on 18 November. EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November. The company launched prepaid streaming passes and reported anti-scam and ESG progress.
notable_en: June Solbekk ceased to be a board member on 18 November.
Elisabeth Melander Stene ceased to be a board member on 18 November.
The company launched streaming passes from RM1 per month for prepaid customers.
risks_en: Chief Strategy, Transformation and Regulatory Officer Datuk Kamal Bin Khalid disposed of 15,000 shares at RM2.90 each on 18 August.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between August and November.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was RM3.186 billion, down 0.7% QoQ and up 0.3% YoY; net income was RM398 million, down 4.8% QoQ and down 9.3% YoY; net margin was 12.5%, lower than 13.0% in the previous quarter.
